videos.title: Qualifying Mitigation Overview with Peter Spilsbury, Sarah Lucas and James Sandy
videos.description:
00:00 Introduction
00:39 Background and understanding potentially mitigable activity 
6:06 Typical assumptions for the extent of mitigation
10:07 Future opportunities
15:19 User guide: understanding the report layout  
18:06 Characterising the mitigator cohorts
19:25 Understanding overlap between mitigator cohorts
20:45 Making comparisons between ICBs
22:24 National and sub-national trends in mitigable activity
25:22 Potential limitations/pitfalls


A short video exploring recent work by the Strategy Unit, funded by NHS England, to help better understand the scale, threats, and regional variations of potentially migitable hospital activity at national and sub-national levels.

This is part of the Strategy Unit's work on the NHS Hospital Programme.
